title: Planted clique detection and recovery from the hypergraph adjacency matrix
summary: Hypergraph data are often projected onto a weighted graph by constructing an adjacency matrix whose $(i,j)$ entry counts the number of hyperedges containing both nodes $i$ and $j$. This reduction is computationally convenient, but it can lose information: distinct hypergraphs may induce the same matrix, and the matrix entries are generally dependent because each hyperedge contributes to multiple pairs.
